verdict.rationale: Warp docs describe multiple retention/deletion controls: terminal I/O is not stored on Warp servers and is never used for training (warp-docs-12), Business/Enterprise plans get a Zero Data Retention agreement (warp-docs-34), users can clear/delete sensitive Blocks from a machine (warp-docs-36), and telemetry can be opted out except on the Free plan where it's required for AI (warp-docs-33, warp-docs-51). This covers meaningful retention/deletion levers but ZDR is enterprise-only and there's no documented self-service 'delete my account data' flow for individual/free users, and independent corroboration is thin (one community post raises consent concerns about session data being sent to LLMs, though this is about consent rather than retention/deletion itself). Missing for 10: consumer-tier data deletion/export mechanism, independent audit confirming retention claims, and clarity on how long AI conversation data persists for non-enterprise tiers.
